turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. My son found out he had a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Start with who decided that.
I'm not here to get it over with, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and what did you have when you did?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My child never lies. "Everyone knows it." Who is everyone, and what document do you have? Because if you have nothing, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I haven't raised my voice, Hale. I asked who decided and on what basis, and you've answered neither. Withdraw the zero, or show me what you have.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You asked for this meeting, Hale. You've told me everyone knows and you haven't shown me one thing. Is there a document, or am I going upstairs?
